name: Deterministic GrowthGraph Skeleton Lab
purpose: Prove that one parametric developmental model can generate smoothly different plant skeleton morphologies from continuous developmental traits and deterministic IndividualSeed without TREE/BUSH/GRASS generator classes.
acceptance_semantics: same development traits + IndividualSeed produce exact GrowthGraph hash
different IndividualSeed changes stochastic realization without changing inherited traits
lower apical dominance increases lateral branching
higher branch probability increases branch count
wider branch angle increases angular spread and crown radius
shorter internode increases axis segmentation while preserving max height
branch-probability sweep changes morphology monotonically without type switching
GrowthGraph remains derived representation and no mesh/biome/species/authority/network/persistence truth is introduced
current visual renderer is accepted only as DEBUG_SKELETON; future visual complexity must consume GrowthGraph through an interchangeable render-description/renderer/LOD layer
